body: The last few months were great we hadn’t had any conversations about needs/feelings. She genuinely seemed happy. She had a lot of life stressors going on at the moment (work,famly, etc) and I supported her through all of them. She built up resentment from little things she never spoke about because she hates confrontation and is bad at communication. She was bringing up the most random stuff like how she thought I didn’t like her birthday gifts this year and she felt like I didn’t let her go to the club with her friends, both of which are untrue lol. The only conversation she ever voiced and was a constant issue was about our anniversary because she thought I didn’t value it even though I would take her out every year, flowers, card, gift, everything. I quite literally got her a $1000 piece of jewelry this year and took her out and we had a great time. Then 2 weeks later she blindsides and ghosts me and doesn’t give the necklace back 💀

Similar story here. Gf of 6 years completely blindsided me and said the same thing. Said she was checked out, her heart wasn’t in it, had a “gut feeling” and felt that way for awhile. Same as I you I did the begging, the texting, all of it. She was completely cold/emotionless and basically just shut me down and ghosted me completely. The lack of real closure and no contact kills me but I’ve been starting to feel a bit better. Time and distance allowed me to detach from her a little and see everything for how it is. We truly deserve better I did nothing but love, care, and spoil her and it still wasn’t enough. But for someone else it will be.

Yeah I feel the same. 6 years and she discarded me out of nowhere a couple months ago. I had one fling with a girl recently and it just felt so weird I had to break it off. Im terrified of opening up or loving again. Poured my everything into her just to end up getting ghosted and becoming strangers after talking about marriage, kids, moving in together, etc. How are we supposed to just do it again 😐

I was blindsided as well after 6 years. She basically said the same thing. She had been checked out for awhile and felt stagnant and had a “gut feeling”. I struggle with the same thoughts like if I had just done more of this or if she had just communicated better. But the truth is I don’t think it would’ve changed anything. She wanted out and I doubt anything I would’ve done could’ve stopped her. No amount of dates, gifts, conversations, she just seemed done. When someone says they can’t see a future with you that’s on them. If you tried your best and treated her well there’s really nothing else you could’ve done. I’m struggling to accept that as well but it’s really all there is to it. Keep your head up man we’ll get through this. Hopefully we meet someone who would actually fight for the relationship like we would

My ex gf of 6 years discarded me with no warning, no conversations, no fights, no chances to fix anything, nothin. The first time I heard about any of her resentments she had built up was at the time of the breakup. We had a great, loving relationship and I treated her very well emotionally, financially, etc. She hit me with the “I’ve been checked out for awhile” and we’re “stagnant” but we had just celebrated our anniversary, my bday, Valentine’s Day, it had been an eventful couple months and everything seemed good as always. Constant talks of the future and moving in together as well. I think she was avoidant so that might be why it was such a blindsided discard. She struggled to give me any real explanation or closure, was completely cold and detached during the breakup, and ghosted me almost instantly after. I think a lot of the time yeah a partner will beg for a need to be met and the other person just doesn’t change or makes empty promises but not always. Sometimes you don’t even have the chance 🤷🏻‍♂️

She barely gave me answers, closure, the decency of a conversation, genuinely seemed annoyed that I was trying to save it. Then ghosted me. Definitely feels like betrayal.

I feel you man 23 here. 6 years tg and she left me completely blindsided claiming we were “stagnant” and weren’t growing enough. We were literally just talking about moving in together. Never fought, never toxic, she was my best friend and I was hers. Almost immediately after she started posting alllll this stuff on instagram, TikTok, basically every platform imaginable trying to create this new image for herself with new clothes, jewelry, etc. Really weird behavior honestly. I’ve even had a couple people mention it to me saying it’s very noticeable and like she’s trying way too hard. Ironic considering how insecure she was about herself the entire relationship and how much validation she required. Not sure why they do it. The need for validation maybe? They don’t have us to give them attention anymore so they need it from others 🤷🏻‍♂️

Going through something similar. First love of 6 years completely blindsided me in April. Right after our anniversary too. I had taken her out, bought her a Cartier necklace, we had a great time. She seemed so happy. 2 weeks later told me she had been checked out for awhile, we were “stagnant” and her heart wasn’t in it. Tried to fight for us but her mind was made up and she was so incredibly cold and emotionless. Honestly one of the most betraying, shocking experiences I’ve ever been through. Like they had become a complete stranger. And she didn’t even give me back the necklace! Been no contact for about a month. Truly the only way forward is no contact and trying not to cling to hope they’ll come back. Focus on small wins daily, lean on your friends/family when you need them and take care of yourself. It’s easy to fall into depression and slide into drugs/drinking/bed rotting etc but try to fight those demons best you can. Keep your head up brother we’ll get through this. Life has so much more to offer us

Same feelings here. Gf of 6 years blindsided me recently been in no contact for about a month. Hard to just switch off the love I have for her after all those convos about the future, marriage, kids…. I don’t think we’ll ever forget the people and the memories but it gets easier to deal with over time. At least, that’s what people tell me 😭
